name: Joachim Stanisław Brudziński - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section VI – European Economic and Social Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Economic and Social Committee spent its 2023 budget of about 159 million euros. Parliament also lists what the Committee should improve: publish clear performance targets, report burnout cases as anonymous data, adopt a missing anti-fraud strategy, spend more on cybersecurity, and explain the savings from sharing buildings and services with the Committee of the Regions. These are recommendations and requests for information, not new laws.

- Parliament formally approves the Committee's 2023 spending and asks for follow-up reports on audits, ethics and buildings.
- The Committee must report back on open audits, the harassment case and its anti-fraud strategy.
- Parliament wants cybersecurity spending raised towards 10% of the joint information technology budget.
